summary: A lock screen and home bar for the EFB, the Flight Deck map inside Navigator, and a quieter phone map.
releaseNotes: The EFB opens on a lock screen over its own wallpaper, with the airline's logo behind it: the time, UTC and local clocks, your flight, the simulator connection and a calendar. Swipe up to open it.
A home bar on the EFB home screen: swipe it up to return to the Flight Deck.
Navigator now shows the Flight Deck map itself, with every layer and control.
The lock screen follows your finger and settles with the same motion as an iPad.
The Stratos wing on the EFB home screen no longer shows a faint square around it.
On a phone, the telemetry strip and the aircraft card open when you tap an aircraft instead of staying on screen.
